title: Jan Hummel - The Rare Advantage of Real-World Experience

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Modern value investing emphasizes investing in resilient franchises and letting the compounding do the work for you.
reader_summary.overview: Modern value investing emphasizes investing in resilient franchises and letting the compounding do the work for you. Today's guest, Jan Hummel. In 2007, Jan launched the Paradigm Capital Value Fund with Bruce Greenwald, the founder of the Heilbrunn Center and Columbia Business School alumnus, Mario Gabelli.

key_points.text: Paradigm's investment philosophy is built around a focus on mispriced securities in the small- and mid-cap space within Europe, deep fundamental research.
I've often mentioned that I think the opportunities in Europe for value investors are enormous and with Paradigm's focus on making investments within the European Union.
